content.value_statement: Database setup can fail when URLs, SSL, and pooling are inconsistent. This skill provides FastAPI and SQLAlchemy patterns for Neon PostgreSQL connections, sessions, health checks, and pool settings.
actual_capabilities: Defines settings patterns for database URLs, pool size, timeouts, recycle intervals, and debug logging.
Shows SQLAlchemy engine creation with connection reuse, pre-ping checks, and PostgreSQL session settings.
Provides FastAPI session dependency patterns that close database sessions after each request.
Documents Neon PostgreSQL SSL requirements and connection string structure with placeholders.
Includes health check, pool monitoring, and Alembic integration guidance for backend projects.
limitations: It does not create databases, accounts, or Neon projects for the user.
It does not perform CRUD modeling, query design, or migration authoring.
It assumes Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL project conventions.
It does not manage secret rotation, credential storage policies, or production access controls.

use_cases.title: Set Up Backend Connections
use_cases.description: Create a consistent connection module for a FastAPI service that uses Neon PostgreSQL.

use_cases.title: Tune Production Pooling
use_cases.description: Adjust pool size, overflow, timeout, and recycle settings for serverless or always-on deployments.

use_cases.title: Review Database Readiness
use_cases.description: Check that SSL, health checks, session cleanup, and Alembic integration are covered before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Configure SQLAlchemy Sessions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a SQLAlchemy engine and FastAPI session dependency for my existing backend.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Pooling for Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare production or serverless connection settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend Neon PostgreSQL pool settings for my deployment model and traffic level.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Database Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my database connection design for SSL, leak prevention, health checks, and Alembic compatibility.

output_examples.input: Review my FastAPI app for Neon connection setup.
output: A settings checklist for database URL, SSL mode, pool size, timeout, and debug values.
A session management plan that opens sessions per request and always closes them.
A health check plan for startup validation and a database status endpoint.

output_examples.input: Help tune database pooling for a Vercel deployment.
output: A smaller pool recommendation for serverless execution.
Timeout and recycle settings that reduce stale connections.
Warnings about connection limits and when to use pooled endpoints.

output_examples.input: Check whether my migration setup uses the same database connection.
output: A review of shared connection settings between the application and Alembic.
Guidance to avoid duplicate configuration across runtime and migration paths.

best_practices: Keep real database URLs in managed environment variables, not in prompts, logs, or source control.
Use SSL requirements, connection pre-ping, and clear timeout values for production databases.
Close sessions reliably and monitor pool statistics to detect leaks before they affect users.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real database credentials in application files or documentation examples.
Do not create a new database engine inside every request handler.
Do not enable verbose SQL logging in production when statements may contain sensitive values.

faq.question: Does this skill create a Neon database?
faq.answer: No. It guides application connection code after a Neon project and database already exist.

faq.question: Can it help with local development settings?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains environment variables, pool settings, and connection string structure for local and deployed environments.

faq.question: Does it cover migrations?
faq.answer: It covers how Alembic should use the same connection settings. It does not write migration scripts.

faq.question: Is it limited to Neon PostgreSQL?
faq.answer: The examples focus on Neon PostgreSQL, but many SQLAlchemy and FastAPI patterns also apply to PostgreSQL generally.

faq.question: Does it store or inspect my secrets?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides setup guidance and placeholder examples. Users should avoid sharing real credentials in prompts.

faq.question: Can it diagnose production connection issues?
faq.answer: It can suggest checks for SSL, pool exhaustion, timeouts, and session leaks. It does not access live infrastructure by itself.
